integrity: The argument is an explicit Vandermonde construction. Correctness is supported by an exact rational-rank checker, while the arbitrary-parameter proof is symbolic and independent of finite computation.
scientific_limitations: The exact lower family is proved for the symmetric generic-bilinear theory. It establishes an exact witness dimension r(k-1) for the constructed formulas and therefore asymptotic linear-order sharpness of the published 2k|V(b)| bound, but it neither improves that universal upper bound nor proves its factor 2 optimal. Alternating forms are not claimed because finite nondegenerate dimensions carry parity restrictions. An uncatalogued folklore antecedent remains possible.
title: Vandermonde witnesses make finite-dimensional dividing bounds linearly sharp
